title: Choose the visual world for Trueshot
question: The roll assigned Sports Card Collection. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Sports Card Collection
options.lineage: Premium sports trading cards — Topps Chrome, Panini Prizm, graded collectibles
options.thesis: Every team is a premium card; comparison is evaluating a trade on dark velvet.
options.viewport: Two team cards face-up on dark felt, gold foil borders catching light. GPR rank stamped as a grading label. Between the cards, a metallic comparison badge. Below, head-to-head results as a stack of result cards.
options.risk: Can feel playful when the user needs serious analysis — mitigate with data-dense card interiors and structured stat blocks.

options.label: Nixie Laboratory Counter
options.lineage: vacuum tube frequency counters and laboratory instruments
options.thesis: Stats as glowing orange digit tubes on a blackened steel chassis — quantities ARE the interface.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: GPR ranks and win rates become physical nixie tube banks; comparison is two counter racks side by side.

options.label: Starship Wall Panel
options.lineage: pill-cornered LCARS-style command consoles with colored elbow frames
options.thesis: Leagues as pastel elbow segments on pure black; the swept frame IS the navigation and the layout grid.
options.case: Bold visual identity: color-coded regions map naturally to league navigation; pill buttons map to teams.

options.label: ASCII Live Scene
options.lineage: live-rendered ASCII art, phosphor terminals, demoscene text mode
options.thesis: All data rendered as monospace glyph density on a green phosphor field — the terminal is the interface.
options.case: Maximally distinctive: gamers read terminal aesthetics as power tools. Monospace naturally aligns stat columns.

canonCard.label: Category Standard
canonCard.thesis: Dark dashboard with angular gaming accents, stat cards with colored bars, hex-shaped badges — what every esports site already ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Slate-gray cards on dark background, team logos in hex frames, neon accent bars on stats, standard responsive grid. Functional, familiar, forgettable.
